mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, auto_pass_score AS autoPassScore, manual_review_score AS manualReviewScore, target_bad_rate AS targetBadRate, threshold_source AS thresholdSource, change_reason AS changeReason, changed_by AS changedBy, create_time AS createTime FROM product_threshold_history WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
